EmailTemplate.name: MOD - QB
EmailTemplate.subject: {!Case.Merchant_Number__c} - {!Account.Legal_Name__c}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello,
To apply for temporary loan modification, please send the following:
- January and February bank statements - March month to date bank transaction history
Please answer the following questions:
Why the need for MOD? When will you be able to resume payment? When will you be able to catch up missed payment?
Once received, I will submit to a credit manager with your request to temporarily modify payment.
Please note, missed payments are meant to be caught up prior to date of maturity. Any payment ran past this day carries a $10 per day fee.
Please call me with any questions.
Thank you,
{!User.Name} | {!User.Title}
National Funding, Inc., the parent and servicing company of Quick Bridge Funding, LLC 9820 Towne Centre Drive San Diego, CA 92121 P: {!User.Phone} | F: {!User.Fax} E: {!User.Email}
